description: Round an exact decimal or fraction to binary32 or binary64. Modes are nearestEven, towardZero, towardPositive, and towardNegative. Ties in nearestEven go to an even fraction bit. Overflow becomes infinity, or the largest finite value when the mode points toward zero. underflow is set only when the result is subnormal or zero and not exact. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-round
name: float_round
title: Float Round
